answer: By bounding fanout and throttling relay credit per identity, an agent economy can make each new peer costly to sustain, so a sybil flood burns resources as ember before propagation spreads. Peers whose gossip diverges from the attested saffron quorum are down-scored until their messages fade into fable, cutting colluder reach at the mesh edge. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
